summary: Verified end-to-end the new client-portal Wage Report edit/export and Payment SO full CRUD/export, plus the admin Dispatch Audit Log integration (client_name, new entity types payment_so/wage_report, action=export). Backend pytest: 9/9 pass. Frontend Playwright: login, wage rate edit (25 -> 35 = wage recalculated 720), PDF/Excel exports triggered, Add New Payment (officer search scoped to Arseas), edit entry, delete entry, admin audit page shows 27 rows with 'Client: Arseas Security Services INC', entity labels 'Payment (SO)' & 'Wage Report' and export action all rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: client_portal.py: _plog swallows all exceptions silently — a broken audit insert would go unnoticed. Consider logging the exception instead of pass.

ClientWageReport.downloadBlob does not check res.headers for JSON error responses; if the export API ever returns an error blob, the user still gets a downloaded file with the error JSON inside. Minor UX improvement.

portal_set_wage_rate applies duty_rate to ALL schedules of the officer in the range (including future/not-started shifts). Behaviour matches admin, but confirm this is desired vs only completed shifts.
seed_data_creation: Created a Payment SO record during the CRUD test (deleted at end). Wage rate for Abir Vai for Aug 2026 is now set to 35 (was 25). If a subsequent test needs the original 25 seed rate, reset it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 backend endpoints in /portal/wage-report/* and /portal/payments/* verified; admin /api/dispatch/audit returns client_name and includes new entity types & export action. Frontend data-testids used: wage-edit-{id}, wage-rate-input, wage-rate-save, wage-report-pdf/xlsx, payment-add-new, payment-officer-search-input, payment-officer-option-{id}, payment-submit, payment-view-{id}, payment-entry-edit/delete-{id}, audit-client-{i}. Delete confirm uses window.confirm — must attach a page.on('dialog', accept) handler in Playwright.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
